records.description: Distribution topology, hosting capacity, feeder/substation constraints, and transformer inventory

records.description: Deduplicated large-load and data-center interconnection queue with probability, timing, site, power quality, backup, and flexibility

records.description: Geographic EV charging load shapes under managed and unmanaged charging

records.description: Generation-to-network locational linkage and realistic interconnection deliverability
